name: Minimum Teaching Set Size of Warmuth's $C_5$ Class
proof: A direct check of the ten cyclic $C_5$ strings shows that no restriction to one or two coordinates distinguishes any one string from all the others.  Each string is distinguished by a restriction to three coordinates (for example, $10010$ is taught on coordinates $0,2,4$).  Thus every concept has minimum teaching-set size three, and so does their minimum.
